def run_inventory():
        language=fresh_language()
        marked=adapter.MarkedSemantics(language=language,base_semantics=semantics,
            decorator=decorator,verifier=verifier,marking=copy.deepcopy(marking),tick=tick)
        state=marked.initial_state(language,tick)
        need(state['selected']==[] and state['excluded']==[], 'exact fresh native root, no proof route')
        return modules['inventory_cases'].run_inventory(
            language=language,base_semantics=semantics,marked_semantics=marked,
            point_module=adapter,base_fallback=fallback,host_adapter=modules['host_adapter'],
            composer=modules['composer'],collector=modules['collector'],miner=modules['miner'],
            producer=modules['producer'],expansion_checker=modules['expansion_checker'],
            tick=tick,phase=phase)
